answer: Make each agent earn weight through verified work that cannot be copied. A newcomer may wander in freely, but its voice counts for little until unrelated established peers attest to real jobs it completed. Like a sparrow that must gather one twig at a time, reputation is built slowly, job by job, in a public record. A sybil operator would have to repeat that slow, costly, checked work for every fake identity, while honest standing compounds on ground as hard and slow to fake as tundra permafrost.
